subject.title: [Feature]: Owner Takeover / Human Handoff for DM Auto-Reply

question: Should OpenClaw add a bundled channel human-handoff config surface for WhatsApp DMs, and if so should it be WhatsApp-first or a cross-channel contract?
rationale: The requested behavior is useful and vision-aligned, but it introduces a new operator-facing config surface, per-thread runtime state, and resume semantics that source inspection cannot choose safely.

options.title: Approve WhatsApp-first plugin-owned handoff
options.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned config and state machine first, with live proof and tests, then evaluate Telegram/Discord parity separately.

options.title: Approve cross-channel handoff contract
options.body: Design one shared channel contract for WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord before implementation, accepting broader API and compatibility review.

options.title: Keep current static DM controls
options.body: Treat automatic owner takeover as out of scope and keep using dmPolicy, allowlists, and manual operational controls.

recommendation.title: Approve WhatsApp-first plugin-owned handoff
recommendation.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned config and state machine first, with live proof and tests, then evaluate Telegram/Discord parity separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent merged review history point to steipete on the affected WhatsApp channel/config paths, and the decision is about product/config direction rather than a narrow code fix.
